fields.name: author
fields.label: Written by
fields.instructions: The name exactly as it appears on the person's user profile. Their bio and portrait are read from that profile when it has them.

fields.name: author_role
fields.label: Job title
fields.instructions: Optional. Left empty, the job title on the person's profile is used.

fields.name: reviewer
fields.label: Technical review by
fields.instructions: Only fill this in once the person has actually reviewed the page and signed it off. Left empty, no review line is shown. The author cannot also be the reviewer.

fields.name: reviewer_role
fields.label: Reviewer job title
fields.instructions: Optional. Left empty, the job title on the person's profile is used.

fields.name: review_date
fields.label: Review date
fields.instructions: The day the review was done. The review line is only shown when a reviewer and a date are both given.
